head.headline: Your call with Arnel is booked.
head.headlineGhost: Here is how to make it count.
head.body: The invite is on its way to your inbox from Cal.com. Three small things below make sure the call happens and is worth your time.
head.quote: “I look at your site before we talk, so the 30 minutes go to your numbers, not to introductions.”

card.title: Before the call
card.sub: Three things that make the 30 minutes count.

invite.title: Accept the invite
invite.body: Find the invite in your inbox and click Yes, so the call and its Google Meet link land in your calendar.

join.title: Join on time, somewhere quiet
join.body: 30 minutes on Google Meet. Have your website and Google Search Console open.

cover.title: What Arnel will cover
cover.body: Where your site stands in Google and AI answers today, what we would do first, and whether we are a fit. The report is yours either way.

genie.tip: of the week the work began

pond.lead: More Google impressions a day outside Pond’s name:

guaranteeBody: 3× your organic traffic, or we keep working for free until you have it. It goes into your agreement, measured in your own Search Console and analytics, with a report every month.
